title: Chapter 9, Verse 3
translation: O conqueror of enemies, persons who lack faith in this path of righteousness do not attain Me. Thus, they return to the continuous cycle of birth and death in this material world.

title: Chapter 9, Verse 30
translation: Even if a person of very improper conduct worships Me with exclusive devotion, he should be considered righteous, because he has made the correct determination.

title: Chapter 9, Verse 31
translation: He quickly becomes righteous and attains lasting peace. O son of Kunti, declare it boldly that My devotee never perishes.

title: Chapter 18, Verse 67
translation: This secret knowledge should never be explained to those who are not austere, or devoted, or engaged in service, nor to one who is envious of Me.

title: Chapter 18, Verse 59
translation: If you think, 'I shall not fight,' relying on your ego, your determination is vain. Your own nature will compel you to act.

title: Chapter 2, Verse 3
translation: O Partha, do not give in to this weakness. It does not suit you. Give up this petty faint-heartedness and arise, O conqueror of enemies.

title: Chapter 4, Verse 35
translation: Having gained this knowledge, O son of Pandu, you will never again fall into such confusion. By this understanding you will see all beings completely within yourself and also within Me.

title: Chapter 9, Verse 3
translation: O conqueror of enemies, persons who lack faith in this path of righteousness do not attain Me. Thus, they return to the continuous cycle of birth and death in this material world.

title: Chapter 13, Verse 8
translation: Humility, pridelessness, nonviolence, tolerance, simplicity, approaching a bona fide spiritual master, cleanliness, steadiness, and self-control;

title: Chapter 14, Verse 24
translation: One who is situated in the self and is equal in distress and happiness; who looks upon a clod of dirt, a stone, and a piece of gold with an equal eye; who is equal toward the desirable and the undesir

title: Chapter 18, Verse 69
translation: There is no servant in this world more dear to Me than he, nor will there ever be one more dear.

title: Chapter 14, Verse 26
translation: And one who serves Me with unswerving devotion transcends these three modes of nature and becomes eligible to attain the level of the Supreme.

title: Chapter 2, Verse 3
translation: O Partha, do not give in to this weakness. It does not suit you. Give up this petty faint-heartedness and arise, O conqueror of enemies.

title: Chapter 18, Verse 78
translation: Wherever there is Krishna, the master of all mysticism, and wherever there is Arjuna, the supreme archer, there will also certainly be opulence, victory, extraordinary power, and morality. That is my

title: Chapter 4, Verse 12
translation: Those who desire quick success in their actions worship the demigods in this world, for in the human realm, the results of material actions manifest very quickly.

title: Chapter 4, Verse 22
translation: One who is satisfied with whatever comes by chance, who has gone beyond the dualities of life, who is free from envy, and who remains steady in both success and failure, is not bound even while perfor

title: Chapter 11, Verse 27
translation: All the warriors rush into Your terrifying mouths with dreadful teeth. Some are seen trapped between Your teeth with their heads crushed to pieces.

title: Chapter 11, Verse 31
translation: Tell me who You are in this terrifying form. O supreme among the gods, I offer my obeisance to You. Please be gracious. I desire to understand You, the original being, for I do not comprehend Your pur

title: Chapter 11, Verse 33
translation: Therefore arise and gain glory. Conquer your enemies and enjoy a prosperous kingdom. These warriors have already been slain by Me. O skilled archer, you are merely an instrument in this process.

title: Chapter 11, Verse 55
translation: One who performs actions for Me, who regards Me as the supreme goal, who is devoted to Me, free from attachment, and free from hostility toward all beings, such a person comes to Me, O Arjuna.

title: Chapter 12, Verse 12
translation: Knowledge is better than mechanical practice, meditation is superior to knowledge, and renouncing the results of actions is greater than meditation. From such renunciation, peace immediately follows.

title: Chapter 12, Verse 13
translation: One who has no hatred toward any being, who is friendly and compassionate, free from possessiveness and ego, balanced in both happiness and distress, and forgiving in nature, is dear to Me.

title: Chapter 12, Verse 17
translation: One who neither becomes overly joyful nor hates, neither laments nor desires, and who has renounced attachment to both good and bad outcomes, such a devoted person is dear to Me.

title: Chapter 13, Verse 10
translation: Non-attachment, absence of entanglement with children, spouse, home, and the rest, and constant even-mindedness amid desirable and undesirable events.

title: Chapter 13, Verse 17
translation: Although the Supreme Truth appears to be divided among all beings, He is never divided. He is situated as one. Although He is the maintainer of every living entity, it is to be understood that He devo

title: Chapter 13, Verse 19
translation: Thus the field of activities, knowledge, and the knowable have been summarily described by Me. Only My devotees can understand this thoroughly and thus attain to My nature.

title: Chapter 13, Verse 24
translation: One who understands this philosophy concerning material nature, the living entity, and the interaction of the modes of nature is sure to attain liberation. He will not take birth here again, regardles

title: Chapter 13, Verse 9
translation: Renunciation of the objects of sense gratification, absence of false ego, the perception of the evil of birth, death, old age and disease.

title: Chapter 14, Verse 14
translation: When an embodied soul passes away while the mode of goodness is predominant, it attains the pure, higher worlds of those who know the Supreme.

title: Chapter 14, Verse 22
translation: The Supreme Lord said: O son of Pandu, one who does not hate illumination, activity, and delusion when they are present, nor longs for them when they disappear...

title: Chapter 15, Verse 13
translation: I enter into each planet, and by My energy, they stay in orbit. I become the moon and thereby supply the juice of life to all vegetables.

title: Chapter 15, Verse 14
translation: I am the fire of digestion in the bodies of all living entities, and I join with the incoming and outgoing breaths to digest the four kinds of food.

title: Chapter 15, Verse 3
translation: The real form of this tree cannot be perceived in this world. No one can understand where it ends, where it begins, or where its foundation is. But with determination, one must cut down this strongly

title: Chapter 18, Verse 4
translation: O best of the Bharatas, now hear My conclusive judgment concerning renunciation. O tiger among men, renunciation is declared in the scriptures to be of three kinds.

title: Chapter 18, Verse 40
translation: There is no being on earth, or even among the demigods in the higher planetary systems, who is freed from these three modes born of material nature.

title: Chapter 18, Verse 49
translation: One whose intellect is unattached everywhere, who has conquered the self, and who is free from desires, attains by renunciation the supreme state of perfection consisting of freedom from action.

title: Chapter 18, Verse 62
translation: Surrender unto Him utterly, O descendant of Bharata. By His grace you will attain supreme peace and the eternal abode.

title: Chapter 2, Verse 7
translation: My nature is overcome by weakness and my mind is confused about my duty. I ask you to tell me clearly what is truly best for me. I am now your student, and I surrender myself to you for instruction.

title: Chapter 3, Verse 13
translation: The spiritually minded, who eat food that is first offered in sacrifice, are released from all kinds of sin. But those who prepare food solely for their own personal enjoyment verily eat only sin.

title: Chapter 4, Verse 10
translation: Freed from attachment, fear, and anger, fully absorbed in Me and taking refuge in Me, purified by the fire of knowledge, many in the past have attained My state of being.

title: Chapter 4, Verse 11
translation: As people approach Me, so I receive them. All paths, O son of Pritha, lead to Me in all respects.

title: Chapter 4, Verse 24
translation: The act of offering is Brahman, the offering itself is Brahman, it is offered by Brahman into the fire of Brahman. One who sees Brahman in every aspect of action ultimately attains Brahman.

title: Chapter 4, Verse 34
translation: Learn that knowledge by approaching a wise teacher with humility, sincere questions, and service. Those who have realized the truth will instruct you in that knowledge.

title: Chapter 5, Verse 10
translation: One who performs their duties without attachment, surrendering the results to the Supreme, is never touched by negative reactions, just as a lotus leaf remains untouched by water.

title: Chapter 5, Verse 17
translation: Those whose intellect, mind, faith, and ultimate refuge are all fixed in the Supreme, whose impurities have been completely cleansed by knowledge, attain the state of no return.

title: Chapter 7, Verse 14
translation: This divine energy of Mine, consisting of the three modes of material nature, is difficult to overcome. But those who have surrendered unto Me can easily cross beyond it.

title: Chapter 7, Verse 24
translation: Unintelligent men, who do not know Me perfectly, think that I, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Krishna, was impersonal before and have now assumed this personality. Due to their small knowledge, t

title: Chapter 7, Verse 26
translation: O Arjuna, as the Supreme Personality of Godhead, I know everything that has happened in the past, all that is happening in the present, and all things that are yet to come. I also know all living enti

title: Chapter 7, Verse 6
translation: Know that all living beings have their source in these two natures (material and spiritual). I am the origin and the dissolution of the entire universe.

title: Chapter 8, Verse 15
translation: After attaining Me, the great souls, who are yogis in devotion, never return to this temporary world, which is full of miseries, because they have attained the highest perfection.

title: Chapter 8, Verse 18
translation: At the beginning of Brahma's day, all living entities become manifest from the unmanifest state, and thereafter, when the night falls, they are merged into the unmanifest again.

title: Chapter 9, Verse 19
translation: O Arjuna, I radiate heat, and I withhold as well as send forth the rain. I am immortality, and I am also death. Both being and non-being are in Me.

title: Chapter 9, Verse 22
translation: But those who always worship Me with exclusive devotion, meditating on My transcendental form—to them I carry what they lack, and I preserve what they have.

title: Chapter 9, Verse 7
translation: O son of Kunti, at the end of the cycle of creation, all beings merge into My material nature. At the beginning of the next cycle, I create them all again.

title: Chapter 10, Verse 29
translation: Among the Nagas I am Ananta; among aquatic beings I am Varuna. Among the ancestors I am Aryama, and among those who enforce discipline I am Yama.

title: Chapter 10, Verse 4
translation: Intelligence, knowledge, freedom from confusion, forgiveness, truthfulness, control of the senses, control of the mind, happiness and distress, birth and death, fear and fearlessness all arise from Me

title: Chapter 10, Verse 41
translation: Whatever being possesses power, beauty, or greatness, understand that it arises from a small portion of My divine splendor.

title: Chapter 11, Verse 49
translation: Do not be afraid or confused after seeing this terrifying form of Mine. Free from fear and with a peaceful mind, behold again My familiar form.

title: Chapter 11, Verse 51
translation: Arjuna said: O Janardana, seeing Your gentle human form again, my mind has become calm. I have regained my awareness and returned to my normal state.

title: Chapter 12, Verse 13
translation: One who has no hatred toward any being, who is friendly and compassionate, free from possessiveness and ego, balanced in both happiness and distress, and forgiving in nature, is dear to Me.

title: Chapter 12, Verse 4
translation: Those who control their senses, remain balanced in all situations, and are dedicated to the welfare of all beings also ultimately reach Me.

title: Chapter 9, Verse 25
translation: Worshipers of the demigods go to the demigods; worshipers of the ancestors go to the ancestors; worshipers of ghosts and spirits go to such beings; and those who worship Me come to Me.

title: Chapter 18, Verse 62
translation: Surrender unto Him utterly, O descendant of Bharata. By His grace you will attain supreme peace and the eternal abode.

title: Chapter 18, Verse 64
translation: Because you are My very dear friend, I am speaking to you My supreme instruction, the most confidential knowledge of all. Hear this from Me, for it is for your benefit.

title: Chapter 2, Verse 31
translation: Furthermore, considering your own specific duty as a warrior, you should not waver. For a warrior, there is no greater good than fighting in a righteous war.

title: Chapter 2, Verse 33
translation: If, however, you refuse to fight this righteous war, abandoning your own duty and reputation, you will certainly incur sin.

title: Chapter 3, Verse 4
translation: Not by merely abstaining from work does a person achieve freedom from action, nor by mere renunciation does one attain perfection.
